pages.title: Rickenbacker Serial Number Lookup & Dating Guide
pages.description: Date your Rickenbacker guitar or bass with our free serial number lookup. Find the serial, read date codes, and compare vintage features in photos.

pages.title: Rickenbacker Pickup Dating: Toaster, Hi-Gain & Horseshoe
pages.description: Identify Rickenbacker horseshoe, toaster and Hi-Gain pickups with photos and timelines. Compare guitar, bass and reissue features with the serial date.

pages.title: Rickenbacker Tuner Dating: Kluson, Grover & Schaller
pages.description: Identify Rickenbacker Kluson, Grover and Schaller tuners. Compare housings, buttons, mounting patterns and model timelines with reference photos.

pages.title: Rickenbacker Knobs & Controls: Identification Guide
pages.description: Compare Rickenbacker cooker, black vintage and silver-top knobs, plus four- and five-control layouts. Use photos and timelines to check dating clues.

pages.title: Rickenbacker Binding, Inlays & Body Dating Guide
pages.description: Date Rickenbacker features using body shapes, checkerboard binding, dot and triangle inlays, soundholes and headstock photos. Account for later reissues.

pages.title: Rickenbacker Tailpieces & Bridges: Dating Guide
pages.description: Identify Rickenbacker R and trapeze tailpieces, Kauffman and Accent vibratos, and bridge details. Compare timelines, photos and signs of replacement parts.

pages.title: Rickenbacker Colors: Fireglo, Mapleglo & Jetglo
pages.description: Compare Rickenbacker Fireglo, Mapleglo, Jetglo, Azureglo and Autumnglo finishes. See color photos and learn what finish can tell you about age and originality.
